cases.desc: state=idle is applied to the root record
state=working is applied
state=done is applied
state=blocked is applied
state=error is applied
state=clear with no records is accepted and leaves no status
unknown state discards the whole report
report without state is discarded
state values are case-sensitive
empty state is discarded
an empty OSC 7501 body is discarded
ST (ESC \\) terminates a report too
a semicolon-separated payload is not the wire format
a JSON payload is not the wire format
a bare state word without key= is not the wire format
app=dsh is stored verbatim
app=dsh-tui is stored verbatim (hyphen is a name byte)
an app with a space violates the name set: skipped, report still applied
an app with / is skipped, report still applied
an app with = is skipped, report still applied
app may be 32 bytes
33-byte app breaks a limit: whole report discarded
title is base64 UTF-8, shown decoded
decoded title may be Unicode
msg is base64; 'Approve?' must be encoded
plain msg=hello is not valid base64: whole report discarded
msg=Approve? has a byte outside the value alphabet: pair skipped, no msg
title=Hello? has a byte outside the value alphabet: pair skipped, no title
a space in a value skips that pair, report still applied
base64 padding on msg is optional
base64 text that decodes to a control character is discarded
base64 text that decodes to invalid UTF-8 is discarded
empty title/msg mean absent, report still applied
empty progress means absent, report still applied
empty kind means absent, report still applied
a 192-byte decoded title is the limit
a 193-byte decoded title is over the limit: discarded whole
a 2048-byte decoded msg is the limit
a 2049-byte decoded msg is over the limit: discarded whole
kind=permission is stored with blocked
kind=question is stored with blocked
kind=auth is stored with blocked
kind is ignored outside blocked
kind is ignored outside blocked
an unknown kind reads as absent, report still applied
progress is stored for working
progress=0 is a value, not absent
progress=100 is stored
progress over 100 reads as absent, report still applied
leading zeroes are decimal, not octal
negative progress reads as absent
fractional progress reads as absent
progress is ignored outside working/blocked
progress is ignored outside working/blocked
progress is ignored outside working/blocked
progress is stored for blocked
unknown keys are ignored, report applied
a 16-byte key (known or not) is accepted
a 17-byte key breaks a limit: discarded whole
a pair without = is skipped, report applied
a pair with an empty key is skipped, report applied
whitespace around keys and values is removed
a repeated key keeps its last value
two OSC 7501 reports in one write are both applied in order
text after a report does not disturb it
a report split across two writes is reassembled (no marker between chunks!)
an id addresses a child record; the root status stays absent
a child record stores its own app
a child id may name a parent that was never reported
an empty id is an invalid id: discards the whole report (0.1.17)
an invalid id (a//b) discards the report
an invalid id (/a) discards the report
an invalid id (a/) discards the report
0.1.17: an id byte outside the value alphabet (@) is skipped => the report hits the ROOT record
0.1.17: an id with a space is skipped => the report hits the ROOT record
a comma is inside the value alphabet, so the id reaches validation: discarded
a 32-byte id segment is allowed
a 33-byte id segment is over the limit: discarded
8 id levels are allowed
9 id levels are over the limit: discarded
an id longer than 128 bytes is discarded
state=clear:id=X removes X and its children, not similar ids
state=clear with no id removes the root and every record
an invalid clear id never falls back to the root record
a child record leaving working does not raise the turn
a 4087-byte body (the parser's max) is accepted
a 4088-byte body is rejected
a body well over the max is rejected
child-record cap: BTreeMap-first eviction when len >= MAX_RECORDS-1 (steady state 255)

status_ms changes only when the root word changes
